chk_discount_value.name: chk_discount_value
chk_discount_value.value: ((type = 'bogo'::discount_type) AND (value IS NULL)) OR ((type = 'percentage'::discount_type) AND (value > (0)::numeric) AND (value <= (100)::numeric)) OR ((type = 'fixed_amount'::discount_type) AND (value > (0)::numeric))

chk_discount_dates.name: chk_discount_dates
chk_discount_dates.value: (ends_at IS NULL) OR (starts_at IS NULL) OR (ends_at > starts_at)

chk_discount_bogo_items.name: chk_discount_bogo_items
chk_discount_bogo_items.value: (type <> 'bogo'::discount_type) OR ((buy_item_id IS NOT NULL) AND (free_item_id IS NOT NULL))

chk_discount_item_id.name: chk_discount_item_id
chk_discount_item_id.value: ((applies_to = 'order'::discount_applies_to) AND (item_id IS NULL)) OR ((applies_to = 'item'::discount_applies_to) AND (type = 'bogo'::discount_type) AND (item_id IS NULL)) OR ((applies_to = 'item'::discount_applies_to) AND (type = ANY (ARRAY['percentage'::discount_type, 'fixed_amount'::discount_type])) AND (item_id IS NOT NULL))

chk_cash_fields.name: chk_cash_fields
chk_cash_fields.value: (method <> 'cash'::payment_method) OR ((amount_received IS NOT NULL) AND (change_amount IS NOT NULL))

chk_void_approved_fields.name: chk_void_approved_fields
chk_void_approved_fields.value: ((void_approved_by IS NULL) AND (void_approved_at IS NULL)) OR ((void_approved_by IS NOT NULL) AND (void_approved_at IS NOT NULL))
